2610.13909.title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
2610.13909.paper_summary: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.
2610.13909.paper_summary_zh: 雖然針對表格數據的深度學習模型最近受到顯著的研究關注，但回歸任務的目標函數選擇仍然是一個未受到充分研究的自由度。幾條研究路線提供了標準均方誤差（MSE）的替代方案，但數據集、骨幹網絡和評估協議之間的差異使得它們的實際效益難以比較。在這項工作中，我們通過對一系列已建立的表格數據集和多個神經骨幹進行系統性的回顧，來填補這一空白。我們的比較顯示，許多提出的目標在適當調整的MSE基準上提供的增益有限或不一致，而分位數損失在測試的骨幹上對MSE產生了一致的整體改善。然後，我們識別出即使在這一強大目標下仍然存在的限制：不同水平的目標噪聲區域可以在不同的訓練時期達到最佳預測性能。因此，單一的全局早停檢查點可能在不確定性區域之間施加妥協，即使該目標可以表示異方差目標分佈。受到這一限制的啟發，我們引入了一種異方差感知的分位數損失擴展，該擴展使用依賴於輸入的標籤平滑作為潛在的補救措施，並在幾個骨幹上改進了分位數損失。總的來說，我們的結果為表格深度學習的回歸目標提供了現代的實證圖景，並突顯了不確定性區域之間最佳停止時間的差異如何限制全局早停的有效性。代碼可在 https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression 獲得。
